text:
alex_nguyen: Heads-up — after last night's KMS alias swap we're seeing SCIM deprovision failures (HTTP 403) and a few SAML assertion verification errors for two customers. Escalating to eng-security.
jess_mcclure: Oof. Do we have the error strings? Sounds like a decrypt/unwrap issue.
alex_nguyen: Pasting a quick log snippet:
```
HTTP 403 POST /scim/v2/Deprovision -> { 'error':'forbidden', 'reason':'invalid_envelope' }
scim-service: kms.Decrypt failed: jwe: invalid tag
saml-verifier: jws.Verify failed: unexpected alg
```
samir_khan: Is this limited to deprovision flows? Any login impact?
alex_nguyen: Provisioning and most logins look fine. Problem is deprovision jobs failing and a handful of SAML-post assertions flagged as 'signature invalid' (customers A & B). No auth downtime reported yet.
priya_singh: My initial thought: alias swap changed the wrapping key or encryption context. Did the rotation change key spec or alg?
alex_nguyen: Rotation was an alias -> new-key swap. No config deploys that I know of. @ops-bot can you confirm rotation details?
ops-bot: KMS alias swap completed at 2026-03-20T02:11:00Z. Method: created new key, updated alias to point at new key. No region changes. No other config changes recorded.
jess_mcclure: Can we grab the full exception/stack and envelope headers (alg/enc)? Please don't paste secrets but include header fields.
alex_nguyen: Stack trace: 
```
scim-service: kms.Decrypt failed: decrypt returned error 'invalid_ciphertext'
saml-verifier: jws.Verify failed: 'unexpected alg: RS256 vs RS1'
```
samir_khan: Weird that saml-verifier complains about alg mismatch. SCIM uses JWE (RSA-OAEP + A256GCM) while SAML uses RS256 signatures. Why simultaneous?
priya_singh: Check CloudTrail for DecryptDenied or EncryptionContext mismatch. If encryption context changed (maybe due to RBAC rename or param rename), KMS will refuse decrypts.
alex_nguyen: CloudTrail shows DecryptDenied / EncryptionContext mismatch for our service principal between 02:11-02:13 UTC. Rewrap job logs show failures for tenants with prefix 'corp-'.
jess_mcclure: EncryptionContext mismatch is a smoking gun. Did we change the context keys the service supplies? Any RBAC/name changes last week?
samir_khan: We did a small RBAC rename last week (role 'admin' -> 'platform-admin') that touched the provisioning service env. Could have altered the context key generation (e.g., 'role' -> 'rbac_role').
priya_singh: If the rewrap job didn't run for some payload types (deprovision envelopes) then they remain encrypted to the old key/context and the new key can't decrypt. Short-term mitigation: revert alias to previous key until we run a complete rewrap.
jess_mcclure: Reverting alias is high-impact but likely quickest fix. Proposed runbook: 1) revert alias to previous key, 2) run rewrap across all tenant buckets (including deprov payloads), 3) validate, 4) do controlled swap with smoke checks. Need owner and approval.
alex_nguyen: I can own the revert now. Who approves emergency revert?
priya_singh: I approve emergency revert. Create a CIRT ticket and notify compliance since this touches customer encryption handling.
samir_khan: Also add a small change to provisioning service to log encryption context headers on failures so we can correlate.
jess_mcclure: Pre-revert checklist: list aliases (command): `aws kms list-aliases --query 'Aliases[?starts_with(AliasName,`alias/redwood-`)]'`, check rewrap logs at s3://redwood-rewrap-logs/2026-03-20/, verify previous key is still enabled.
alex_nguyen: Running checks now. Aliases: alias/redwood-scim -> key/abc123 (new). Previous key id xyz789 still exists and is Enabled. Rewrap logs: failures for tenant ids corp-* at 02:12 UTC. Initiating revert.
ops-bot: action: alias swap requested by alex_nguyen at 02:40 UTC — pending manual approval.
priya_singh: Approved. Add rollback reason: 'Decrypt errors causing SCIM deprov 403s'. Tag SEC and compliance.
alex_nguyen: Alias pointed back to previous key at 02:42 UTC. Observed immediate drop in 403s and deprovision retries are succeeding. Leaving alias reverted while we run a full rewrap for impacted tenants.
jess_mcclure: Nice. Postmortem action items: - update rewrap job to include deprov payloads, - add encryption-context unit tests and a staging smoke test for rotations, - add pre-rotation decrypt check against sample envelopes, - annotate rotation events in audit trail (who/why/runbook link).
priya_singh: I'll draft a short compliance memo and ensure the rotation event is logged in our audit binder.
samir_khan: I'll add a 72h fallback in provisioning to accept prior context keys when decrypt fails (feature flagged) to reduce future blast radius.
alex_nguyen: Created ticket SEC-7853 with CloudTrail links, rewrap logs, timeline, and the alias revert delta. Assigning to eng-ops for rewrap and eng-security for follow-up.
jess_mcclure: Also schedule a canary rotation in staging that runs rewrap + alias swap for a canary tenant before any prod swap.
priya_singh: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate customer communications for A & B and flag the incident in the compliance tracker.
